title: Super Army War
sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

rows: you fly/drive a vehicle (a helicopter at the start) over the battlefield and support your troops

widgets.text:
The top bar shows the front line with both sides' flags and bunkers; your lives, money ($) and stars are on the HUD
Extra lives ("Extra credit") are awarded during play

Change vehicle is an option in the game; each vehicle has its own weapons
Weapons need reloading; reload bonuses appear on the battlefield
Watch your fuel/health and return to base when needed

Bunkers can be captured, cleared or lost: capture them to push the front line toward the enemy
Hitting civilians gives a penalty: aim carefully near villages
Tanks, aircraft and soldiers attack from the enemy side

The bar at the top of the screen is the map: flags and bunker icons show who holds which part of the front
Push the front all the way to the enemy side to win the mission

Money ($) is earned in missions; stars rate how well you are doing
Special weapons "Big Wave" and "Broken Arrow" are won during play and activated from the menu
Bonus messages tell you when you earn credits, extra lives or reloads

Missions in order; capturing bunkers and keeping your own decides the outcome
Losing bunkers moves the front back toward your base

notes: reference rewritten from the game itself (ROM text and the screen): it is a side-view action game, not a turn-based strategy game
